'''Droid drop ships''' were craft used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] were carried on-board the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the Trade Federation [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]<ref name="SW:OW" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Three of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] drop ships were landed in the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|latter stages]] of the invasion.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid drop ships appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']].
